name: ai-workflow
description: AI engineering pipeline with /workshop (spec approval), /orchestrator (orchestrated design→implement→review→QA→document), and /audit (codebase audit). Includes ticket-reviewer, designer, backend/frontend engineers, code-reviewer, qa-tester, and writer agents.

alwaysOn.title: Always On
alwaysOn.description: Show the agent teams pane whenever a session starts. Off: a button above the prompt opens it.

iconsOn.title: Icons On
iconsOn.description: Show each agent's icon in the agent teams pane.
